procedure: Freeze exact provider/model/account, SDK SHA, rule fixture hash, prompt, token limit and thinking mode before any calls.
Blind ON/OFF and repeat labels; label each answer for applicability, followed/violated/not_applicable/misapplied, and malformed/failed answers separately.
Have a human independently label the same fixed window; preserve raw judge verdicts and count agreement/disagreements and invalid verdicts.
Resolve calibration disagreements before interpreting efficacy; scripted answers test plumbing only.
Report eligible, labeled applicable, valid, invalid, unrun and not-applicable denominators, per-repeat deltas/variance, measured/missing latency and actual/unknown cost.
